subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: May a QQ direct-conversation participant approve sensitive plugin operations without a concrete `allowFrom` or `execApprovals.approvers` identity?
rationale: The linked PR equates direct-chat placement with approval authority, but open DM policy can admit actors who are not the bot owner; repository evidence does not establish that QQ C2C callbacks carry a trusted owner binding.

options.title: Keep Explicit Authorization
options.body: Preserve the current allowlist boundary and add clear setup and rejection guidance for approval-only access.

options.title: Trust Verified Owner DMs
options.body: Allow the shortcut only when QQ callback identity can be proven to match the configured bot owner, with live authorized and unauthorized actor proof.

options.title: Trust Every Direct Chat
options.body: Allow any participant admitted to a C2C conversation to resolve sensitive approval prompts without explicit authorization.

recommendation.title: Keep Explicit Authorization
recommendation.body: Preserve the current allowlist boundary and add clear setup and rejection guidance for approval-only access.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged QQ Bot approval work introduced and documented the current explicit authorization boundary.
